descriptions.autoUpdateSubscriptions: Keep URL subscription groups fresh automatically.
descriptions.customInterval: Choose how often Kagerou checks remote subscriptions.
descriptions.autoConnect: Connects to the last active profile when Kagerou starts.
descriptions.tunMode: Applies the next time you connect.
descriptions.systemProxyUnavailable: Not implemented yet — Kagerou does not change your system proxy.
descriptions.logLevel: Applies the next time you connect.
descriptions.testUrl: Fetched through the VPN to measure its delay. Something small that answers from anywhere works best.
descriptions.geoLookup: Asks a public service, through the tunnel, which country and city your connection appears to come from. Turning this off keeps the dashboard on the flag in the profile name.

validation.positiveInteger: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
